title: Praxis at degree 3312 with scalar-relative auxiliary degree 23
claims: params.json is a parameter set of Praxis for the reference statement at 100-bit security whose ciphertext is 6780 MiB (6.6209 GiB) and whose time, one encryption plus one expected decryption, is 1537359 million field multiplications (17102 and 1520257), by the protected model, and every rule of the model as amended holds for it; proof.md proves that each amended entry (I3, Ncmp, I6, I4, n2, dec_msm_g1, dec_msm_g2, dec_pairings, n1, C6, C7, dec_sum_g2, H2, P1, C5, n, H3) is sound, so that the paper's theorems hold for these parameters as rules.md requires.
